name: Thiwanka Saranatha
headline: Senior .NET Developer | Payment Backend Domain Lead
bio: Grew up in Sri Lanka, now building software from Stockholm, Sweden.
about: Senior .NET Developer with 8+ years building backend systems across fintech and enterprise SaaS. Progressed from .NET Developer to Domain Lead for Rebtel's Payment Backend, architecting distributed, event-driven systems and end-to-end payment integrations. Strong background in .NET Core, cloud (Azure, Kubernetes), and domain-driven design, with a track record of evaluating technical trade-offs, driving architectural consensus across stakeholders, and raising team-wide code quality and test coverage.

recommendations.name: Anna Cantrell
recommendations.title: VP of Engineering at Rebtel
recommendations.text:
I worked with Thiwanka for three years, and he was such a pleasure to work with. He's an endlessly curious backend developer who loves learning, sharing what he knows, and tackling a challenge. He brings enthusiasm to even the most complicated problems, and he's a warm, kind teammate who enjoys both learning from others and mentoring fellow developers.

Thiwanka was one of the first developers in the company to begin experimenting with AI early on in its progression, finding genuinely impactful ways for it to save the company significant time and money. From the earliest outset Thiwanka remained a leader in AI development tools and practices.

When one of our most experienced developers left, Thiwanka took ownership of our payments area, one of the most complex and consequential parts of our platform. He not only took ownership of the domain but he meaningfully improved upon it, adding much-needed testing, and delivering new functionality that made a measurable impact on the business.

I'd happily work with Thiwanka again. Any team would be lucky to have him.

recommendations.name: Can Bakış
recommendations.title: Engineering Manager | AI Lead
recommendations.text: I was very happy have Thivanka in my team, he's work ethics, friendly approach to solving any kind of problem, made it easy for everyone around him to be productive. He also helped me a lot when I was new in the company, guiding me around tech stack and giving great information with relevant context. I have no doubt that Thivanka is always going to be a well appreciated member of any team, and I see the potential in him to become a great leader. He always delivers results with speed and quality, takes the challenges with a smile and makes the lives around him around workplace easier. Highly recommended!
